changelog:
Initial release of the felo-search skill:

- Provides real-time web search for current events, news, trends, location queries, shopping, and more.
- Triggers automatically on information queries where up-to-date results are needed, with multi-language support.
- Guides users through API key setup and environment variable configuration.
- Executes queries via Bash using the Felo API, handling special characters robustly.
- Parses and formats API responses for clear, markdown-style output.
- Includes comprehensive usage examples and error-handling instructions.
summary: Felo AI real-time web search for questions requiring current/live information. Triggers on current events, news, trends, real-time data, information queries,...
